title: SCRIPT
features:
Boot guard preventing duplicate script launches in the same server (PlaceId:JobId).

Toggle state persistence to onrusha_autofarm_state.json and executor environment.

Remote UI library loading from GitHub with KeyGate patch for permanent keys.

KeyGate key system with online validation and Discord link.

Custom UI: Matcha theme, scale 0.82, draggable, mobile support, blur, Starfall background effect, RightShift toggle.

Speed slider (WalkSpeed 16-250).

Auto Give Me with configurable threshold (3-10).

Auto Lift with configurable interval (0.3-10s).

Auto Item: item collection and delivery to base hole.

Speed modes: Adaptive / Fixed.

Priority: Most Expensive / Cheapest / Nearest / Farthest / Balanced.

Min/max weight and max pickup distance filters.

Smooth interpolation movement and underground pathing.

AuxHoles support (zones >=2, "Linked to your base").

Camera tilt down before throw and restore.

Pickup retries, item list refresh, watchdog for hangs.

Auto Sell Item: sells artifacts from ArtifactInventory.

Auto Strenght Upgrade: buys Strength upgrade when affordable, teleports to shop and back.

Auto Base Upgrade: evolves base when all requirements met.

Anti Punch: disables Ragdoll / FallingDown / PlatformStanding states.

Auto Reconnect: reconnects on errors/teleports.

Reload via queue_on_teleport.

Ban message detection with auto-disable.

Shared state between script copies, timeouts and retries.

Item ESP: highlights spawned items.

Weight-based color gradient (up to 75k) or solid color.

Configurable fill/outline color and transparency.

Weight label (BillboardGui) with color and size settings.

Player ESP: highlights players and shows names.

Configurable colors, transparency, name visibility, text size.

DepthMode = AlwaysOnTop.

Auto-refresh on player join/leave.
